topic: Natural Language Processing in Electronic Health Records in Relation to Healthcare Decision-making: A Systematic Review
topic_definition: Stage 1 observable projection of the original paper's eligibility. Use title and abstract evidence to judge whether the study is an original ML- or DL-based study of EHRs, clinical notes, medical notes, clinical narratives, or medical free text in a healthcare setting. Full-text-only checks such as peer-review nuance, full conference-paper status, and quality examination are deferred to Stage 2.
summary: Stage 1 title/abstract projection of source-faithful Stage 2 criteria; publication-time filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2306.12834.json.

summary_topics.description: Natural Language Processing in Electronic Health Records in Relation to Healthcare Decision-making: A Systematic Review

required.criterion: Title/abstract indicates that the study uses machine learning or deep learning methods on EHRs, electronic health records, clinical notes, medical notes, clinical narratives, or clinical free text.
Title/abstract indicates a healthcare, hospital, medical, or clinical setting rather than a general non-clinical text-mining task.

Observable task signal fits at least one covered topic type, such as free-text classification, word embeddings, clinical-narrative summarization, healthcare dialogue systems, medical concept embedding, delirium risk identification, ICD coding, clinical entity recognition, or ML/DL architectures for EHRs.
When the EHR/clinical-text ML fit is plausible but full-text-only eligibility details are incomplete, keep maybe and defer final confirmation to Stage 2.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Title/abstract clearly indicates the paper is not about EHRs, clinical text, medical notes, clinical narratives, or healthcare text data.
Title/abstract clearly indicates no ML or DL method is used for the clinical text or EHR task.
Title/abstract or metadata clearly indicates a review paper, editorial, preprint, preliminary work, or other non-peer-reviewed publication form.
